environment: GitHub Actions Ubuntu; disposable synthetic in-memory; no remote db calls
scenario: 1 changed verification row in an existing set of N; remote UnitOfWork, StatePort and repository contract real; unit test fixture and bridge synthetic
interpretation: Six counted clones of whole verification collection per one changed row in tested UnitOfWork/StatePort path; median CPU duration scales approximately linearly with unrelated rows.
caveats: Node test is not a UI or Production timing benchmark; no Supabase, RLS, Realtime, triggers or DOM work.

Synthetic verification objects have one competence and one school per row, and are much smaller/different than real records; scaling mechanism is supported but absolute timings are not Production estimates.
Record clone occurrences mean repeated copies, not distinct verification IDs.
Five sequential samples per volume on one runner do not establish service-level bounds.
The legitimate purpose of the copies is transaction rollback, isolation and consistency. Do not remove until same guarantees demonstrated.
